data.notes: June 2026 is especially strong for destination dance weekender formats in Malta, with R&B, UK garage, house, Afro-house and techno events clustered around Café del Mar, UNO Malta and Ta’ Qali.

events.title: DLT Malta 2026
events.summary: DLT Malta returns for its final edition, “The Last Dance,” with a 2026 lineup led by Brandy plus KWN, Lloyd, DVSN, Musiq Soulchild, Isaiah Falls and Soulection Takeover with Joe Kay.

events.title: The Travellers - 10 Snin Ta’ Mużika
events.summary: Maltese band The Travellers mark ten years with their biggest live show to date at MFCC, billed as a full-scale anniversary concert celebrating their decade of local hits.

events.title: TENSION Festival presents &FRIENDS
events.summary: TENSION Festival returns to Café del Mar Malta with &FRIENDS headlining an Afro-house and tech-house sunset-to-night party, supported by ANT Mifsud.

events.title: Sidewinder Malta 2026
events.venueName: Café del Mar, Tortuga Beach, Gianpula Village, Toy Beach Club and Toyroom
events.summary: Sidewinder’s Malta weekender spans three days and five venues, with pool parties, an outdoor festival, afterparties and boat-party add-ons focused on UK garage, R&B, bassline and house.

events.title: Mon Cheri Presents: Shimza
events.summary: Mon Cheri brings South African Afro-house artist Shimza back to Café del Mar Malta for a sunset special as part of the G7 Summer 2026 tour.

events.title: Scorpions Live in Concert
events.summary: German hard-rock band Scorpions bring their Coming Home tour to MFCC, Ta’ Qali, with a set expected to feature career-defining anthems such as “Rock You Like a Hurricane” and “Wind of Change.”

events.title: ABODE On The Rock 2026
events.summary: ABODE On The Rock returns to Malta with a four-day festival pass and first announced artists including Jamie Jones, Max Dean, Luke Dean, Gaskin, Jammer, Ilario Alicante, Candidate, Lauren Lo Sung and Prunk.

events.title: Pioneer Plays Malta 2026
events.venueName: Multiple venues, including UNO and Treehaus
events.summary: Pioneer Plays stages a Malta weekender of welcome parties, flag-themed day events, boat and pool parties, a neon party at UNO and Treehaus, and an all-white beach-club party.

events.title: TWO ROCKS presents Maceo Plex
events.summary: TWO ROCKS and IN ACT bring Maceo Plex to UNO Malta for a techno and tech-house night, with ANT Mifsud also listed on the lineup.

events.title: GALACTICA - Week 1
events.summary: Galactica opens its Malta summer residency at UNO, launching a run of hard-techno Friday dates scheduled through late August.

events.title: VORTEX – TWOFACED
events.summary: VORTEX hosts New Zealand duo TWOFACED at Liquid Club, with Damz and Billy Hills also listed for a night spanning modern hard house, trance-edged club sounds and techno.

events.title: Hacked Festival
events.summary: Hacked Festival presents a day-to-night techno lineup at Aria Complex including CLTX, Alignment, ANXHELA, MADMAN, DJ ANGEL, Tham, Rensei, SLIZER and local support.
